```
SHOW DATABASES  ->  SELECT SCHEMA_NAME FROM SYS.EXA_SCHEMAS
SHOW SCHEMAS    ->  SELECT SCHEMA_NAME FROM SYS.EXA_SCHEMAS
```

(`SHOW TABLES` is already transpiled to Exasol.)
